name: stentor
description: Listen to Claude Code's answers: a free voice that runs on your computer reads them aloud. Key 1 reads the reply on screen, a play mark on hover reads any reply, 2 stops, 3 switches the voice

voices.title: Voices
voices.description: Comma-separated Kokoro voices that key 3 cycles through. The first letter sets the language: e Spanish, a US English, b British English, f French, i Italian, p Portuguese, h Hindi, j Japanese, z Chinese. Examples: em_alex,ef_dora or af_heart,am_michael
